claims.claim: An applicant must have reached State Pension age.
claims.quote: You can get Attendance Allowance if you’ve reached State Pension age and the following apply:
claims.note: The source makes reaching State Pension age an eligibility condition.

claims.claim: Being 66 or over meets the Attendance Allowance age condition.
claims.quote: The State Pension age for men and women will now increase to 67 between 2026 and 2028.
claims.note: State Pension age is rising above 66, so being 66 is not always enough.
